mainEntity.name: Who are SHRED classes suitable for?

acceptedAnswer.text: SHRED classes are suitable for individuals looking to improve their fitness, increase strength, and boost endurance. While they are high-intensity, exercises can often be modified to accommodate various fitness levels, from beginners to advanced athletes. It's helpful to have a basic level of fitness and no current injuries that would be exacerbated by high-impact or intense movements. Discussing any concerns with a coach beforehand can help determine if it's the right fit.
